adjudication: Physical flags remain provisional. Unresolved registration or phase-assignment ties that change A produce explicit bounds. Verifier errors are not agent zeros.
adoption: Rounding-aware complete-project consistency checks; numerical score definition and physical screens unchanged. See ../report/ROUNDING_REPAIR.md.
aggregation: Average repeats within each case, then cases equally; keep dataset, split and condition separate. Show all-attempt provisional means and fixed common adjudicated-case means with explicit denominators.
hard_failure: Malformed top-level submission or unequivocal hard physical failure scores zero. Invalid individual model records count as unmatched assertions; preserve other valid structure credit. Preserve component diagnostics before the physical gate.

partial_submissions.explicit_unresolved_balance: Preserve known absolute mass fractions summing below one when an unresolved balance is explicitly declared. No primary profile credit or renormalization.
partial_submissions.invalid_model: Count an invalid asserted atomic model as an unmatched prediction; do not silently discard it or redistribute its weight.
partial_submissions.legacy_compatibility: Recognize explicit unresolved/indexed records embedded in phases when no atomic model and no numeric mass fraction are supplied.
partial_submissions.mass_credit: sum(q * min(reference_fraction, submitted_fraction)) for assigned quantified phases; unweighted abundance retained as a diagnostic
partial_submissions.models: Score readable atomic phase models independently of missing fraction fields. Explicit unresolved records without atomic models are not identified phases.
partial_submissions.profile: Primary profile credit requires the entire asserted atomic-model set and a complete valid normalized fraction vector. Otherwise this component receives zero. Free-fraction fits remain diagnostics only.
partial_submissions.unknown_weights: P=0; retain F and quantified terms of A without imputation

physical_screen.note: Existing necessary validity checks, applied identically to targets and submissions. The O-O flag is a review trigger specific to this oxide application, not a universal chemical prohibition.
physical_screen.raw_cif_occupancies: Reject nonfinite, negative or greater-than-1.0001 raw site occupancies before import; do not let a parser discard invalid atoms silently.

profile.angular_calibration: Retain the submitted GSAS-II zero, instrument and polarization. No true calibration is substituted.
profile.expected_mean: hidden generation mean, read only after project prediction and consistency checks are complete
profile.nuisance: All fitted instrument, specimen, background, scale and atomic parameters retained from final.gpx. No evaluator optimization.
profile.reference: unrefined generating mean compared to original observations; diagnostic only
profile.solver_measurement_diagnostics: Recompute original-grid Rwp from verified final.gpx; fit.csv and declared scalar statistics remain separate untrusted diagnostics.

project_replay.background: Preserve native background basis on saved fit interval; evaluate or extrapolate over original grid.

consistency.purpose: Numerical floors plus half-last-printed-digit rounding intervals, propagated through units/symmetry. Parenthesized standard uncertainties do not widen these intervals. Declared CIF ADPs are checked when present; omitted ADPs are supplied by the project.
consistency.rounding_rule: Half a last printed decimal digit from each serialized value; bare integers/rational constants treated as exact. Fraction-vector tolerance unchanged.

project_replay.isolation: GPX parsed only in bwrap with public observations, pinned scientific runtime, isolated outputs, no hidden truth or network.
project_replay.missing_or_inconsistent_project: P=0; retain structural/abundance credit and explicit partial-submission status
project_replay.original_grid: all bins; saved exclusions do not remove scoring bins
project_replay.physical_review: Negative atomic displacement tensors (eigenvalue below -1e-8 A2), negative analytic total peak widths, negative background, out-of-range polarization and auxiliary background peaks flag provisional interpretation.
project_replay.unsupported_valid_model_or_evaluator_fai: null score with verification_error; never converted to an agent zero

soft_matching.definition: Symmetrized periodic same-element occupied-population transport, Gaussian distance kernel; phase assignment independent of fractions.
